name: containerlab-app
description: Monorepo for Containerlab web, desktop, VS Code extension, and shared UI.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run dev --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.dev:web:local: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run dev:local --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run dev --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build --workspace containerlab-app-web && npm run build --workspace containerlab-desktop && npm run build --workspace vscode-containerlab
scripts.build:web: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build:pages --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run package --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:linux: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run package:linux --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:mac: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run package:mac --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:win: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run package:win --workspace containerlab-desktop
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run dev:pages --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run check:release-version && npm run check:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck:local-ui: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run typecheck:local-ui --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e:web: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run test:e2e --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.test:e2e:web:local-ui: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run test:e2e:local-ui --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.test:e2e:web:smoke: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run test:e2e:smoke --workspace containerlab-app-web
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build --workspace vscode-containerlab
scripts.dev:vscode: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run build:watch --workspace vscode-containerlab
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run package --workspace vscode-containerlab
scripts.test:e2e:vscode: npm run build:clab-ui && npm run test:e2e --workspace vscode-containerlab
